supported_configuration: 5.020 documents --timing and --threads N and its timing act scheduler plus V3Order partitioner without a timing/thread mutual exclusion. Combination is documented/sourced as supported; this actual top has not been translated or run with --threads4 in this review.
idle_worker_identity: AT014 gdb dump, not a claimed current-live process count or144-thread observation
pool_controls: VerilatedContext::threads(n) before constructing the model; thread count includes main. threads1 returns null pool; threads4 makes3 workers. taskset0-3 bounds inherited affinity but does not override hardware_concurrency default pool size. Setting context4 with current model threads1 creates idle workers and does not partition the model.

UNOPTFLAT.interpretation: Circular process-level dependency needs hybrid logic and repeated convergence; data dependencies constrain coarse-task parallelism and synchronisation remains. Four requested threads cannot establish4x gain or remove those26 loops. UNOPTTHREADS reports inability to fill requested threads; no whole-design serial inference is made from UNOPTFLAT alone.

source_semantics: Only simulator translation/main configuration would change; preserve exact RTL/TB/gold/runtime fixedbatch512/converge512/assertions/flags/fixtures. Equal semantic events and cycles and original numerical checks are mandatory; divergence fails equivalence.

minimal_AB_proposal.A: Current --threads1 model, explicitly set contextp->threads(1) before model constructor. Compile only wrapper/main and relink exact existing generated model/runtime objects.
minimal_AB_proposal.B: Same inputs/options except --threads4 and explicit contextp->threads(4). Translate into fresh Mdir, compile full newly generated model and wrapper against the same isolated runtime, then link; never reuse model objects against changed generated root headers.
minimal_AB_proposal.endpoint: Existing kind5 checker +PACKED=0 +STOP_AFTER_HEAD=1, all other stop selectors0; same first complete head endpoint both arms, each original120s cap. No TB/assertion edits or new endpoint.
minimal_AB_proposal.measurement: CPU0-3/nice19/idle and one heavy lock, record model threads()/actual task counts/affinity. Compare BEGIN-to-original checked head0 DONE wall time alongside identical semantic-event/cycle sequences and original gold. One pair only supports this measured scope, not stable speedup or full Encoder feasibility.
minimal_AB_proposal.falsification: Any cycle/event/value difference rejects equivalence; no wall reduction at the same complete endpoint rejects this pair as a performance improvement. Timeout/build-cost stop preserves NOT_COMPLETED.
minimal_AB_proposal.authority: Proposal only. A012 exclusively owns E021 and tool runner; controller must allocate actual EDA window and budget before any build/run.
